card.name: Reserve and test after organ-function terms
card.fires_on: The word "reserve" after an organ name such as adrenal, pituitary or respiratory, and "test" after stimulation or breath. It appears in function-testing passages.

modes.label: Reserve after organ
modes.description: The word reserve follows an organ or system adjective, describing capacity.

modes.label: Test word in diagnostics
modes.description: The word test ends a diagnostic name such as breath or ACTH stimulation test.
modes.example: Ingestion of antimicrobials or bismuth preparations within two weeks prior to performing the<< breath>> test.

card.plain: It marks the word reserve or test when a passage discusses how well an organ responds or is tested.
